en.name: Lenovo ThinkPad E14
en.shortDescription: 14" business laptop, Intel Core i5, 8 GB RAM, durable ThinkPad build.
en.description:
## Lenovo ThinkPad E14

A reliable 14-inch business laptop with the legendary ThinkPad keyboard and MIL-SPEC durability testing.

- Intel Core i5-1335U
- 8 GB or 16 GB RAM
- 512 GB NVMe SSD
- TrackPoint and spill-resistant keyboard

## Lenovo ThinkPad E14

Laptop ganacsi oo la isku halleyn karo oo 14 inch ah, leh kiiboodhka caanka ah ee ThinkPad iyo tijaabo adkaysi heer MIL-SPEC ah.

- Intel Core i5-1335U
- 8 GB ama 16 GB RAM
- 512 GB NVMe SSD
- TrackPoint iyo kiiboodh biyo iska celiya
